scope: Producer lifecycle instrumentation and stricter resource-study admission. No real model TTL0/10/30 study, default change, resource saving or quality improvement claim. Independent from rejected native candidate14 and Q16.

protocol.bounded_storage: Monotonic counters plus one last release; no prompts, text, command lines or unbounded event history.
protocol.unknown_exit: Always sticky other_releases; cannot be hidden by a later successful release.
protocol.release_sequence: Allocated after actual cleanup/wait, in completion order.
protocol.zero_ttl_batch_grace: Existing2s in-batch grace is classified as batch_grace_expired, not configured TTL.
protocol.calibration: Direct calibration sessions are excluded from pooled-release evidence.
protocol.admission: Count an overall failed open_session once after bounded CPU fallback; pooled startup child releases still recorded.
protocol.stop_order: Stop signal and closing use one stop-state mutex; pool accounting/invalidation and kill/wait cleanup do not hold that mutex in reverse order. Rejected stale stops cannot set global cancellation.

consumer_guards: Missing/inconsistent/adverse lifecycle data, counters that reset, wrong policy history, unknown exit or reason, and replaced PID are rejected.
A vacant pool slot is not confirmed exit; both CLI timestamp and consumer deadline require confirmed matching PID release.
Every chat job needs its own unique prior worker, sequential nonoverlapping attempts and a closed successful terminal.
Failed or missing responses and malformed trace costs remain unknown in totals; observed cost survives rejection.
Final process/trace summarization errors cannot skip cleanup of this harness arm's owned model links.

actual_empty_cli.scope: Real empty CLI producer-to-consumer schema only; no loaded model, TTL study, resource or GPU claim.

real_child_tests.scope: Synthetic sleeping children only. Real kill/wait, sticky unknown exit, resource/cancel/ASR-backlog reasons, pooled startup/calibration distinction, eligible memory refusals, admission and concurrent detached cleanup.
real_child_tests.clock: 250ms real monotonic TTL check; other classification tests backdate fixture clocks. Not a10s/30s model-residency observation.
real_child_tests.concurrency_limit: Existing detached cleanup may overlap a newer lease. This does not prove only one OS child exists during cleanup.
real_child_tests.test_error_injection: Unknown exit is injected only after real child cleanup so the negative test does not leak a process.

next_steps: Keep P1 independent of0.3.5candidate while Q16 manual article-history retention remains unresolved.
Run real same-model reversed-order TTL0/10/30 arms only after producer/consumer source is frozen; retain failures, all cost, model/runtime identity and process-tree observations.
Do not promote a TTL default from synthetic children or empty CLI schema.
